role: Healer by regrowth: heals the body over time (bar first, wounds slowly) and works only on the living.
reflux_why: Unchanged. Body work is careful, ordinary work, and a healer must keep casting through a fight without locking up. Middling is the reference tier.
rule: Life works inside living bodies: its harm passes armour and hits the hale (above half health) 25% harder, it does nothing to the unliving, and it heals over time - you and your living summons, the bar fast and wounds slowly - half as fast again for 2 s after each hit you land.
rule_why: The 2026-10-22 rule kept, plus one clause for the role: a heal must be worth casting in a solo action game, so every Life heal over time runs faster while you are trading blows. The healer is pushed to fight, not to stand back. The bar/sink split is kept: only Regrowth fills sinks at a useful rate.
band_shift: Hits lighter than the bands (needle 45, sweep 1.7x, grip 2.0x): Life's power is in its heals. Heal skills sit at mid cost (10-14); a full Knit is about 30 health, 45 with the after-hit rule, against 100 health and enemy blows of 10-45.

skills.name: Knit
skills.summary: For 6 s you, and every living summon of yours within 6 m, regain 5 health a second - half as fast again for 2 s after each hit you land. It fills the bar up to the ceiling your wounds allow; once the bar is full, the rest seeps into your oldest wound at a quarter rate. A blow does not break it.
skills.verb_fit: Heal is restoring health and closing wounds. Knit does both in the order the body does: the bar first, quickly, then the wounds, slowly.
skills.change: Living summons within 6 m share it (radius added). Faster after your hits, by the affinity rule.

new_mechanics.name: life healing
new_mechanics.definition: Unchanged from the 2026-10-22 draft: heal points go to body.heal() up to total_max(), then to body.fill_sinks() at overflow_to_sink, oldest wound first; never a lost arm; separate from talent healing.

new_mechanics.name: heal_mult_after_hit
new_mechanics.definition: Affinity rule key: for after_hit_s after the player lands any hit (strike, skill or shot) on an enemy, every Life heal over time on the player runs at x heal_mult_after_hit.

new_mechanics.name: shared buff (radius)
new_mechanics.definition: A self_buff with radius also puts the same buff, for the same time, on every summon of the caster within radius at the moment of casting. If the affinity has living_only, only living summons take it. Used by Life, Nature and Holy.

good_modifiers.word: a slower, longer knitting: half as long again
the body keeps rebuilding: 40% longer
the knitting is given wider: 10% further to your summons, a quarter longer
a cheaper mend: 15% less essence

bad_modifiers.why: harm from within, put into your own healing. A self buff hits nobody, so Withering has nowhere to land; it falls back to a small cost cut.
stopping the healing you are doing. Arrested has no one to land on; the verbs cancel and the word should not form.

skills.name: Withering Needle
skills.summary: A needle of life turned inward. The first enemy hit takes 45 and 1 Withering (7 a second for 6 s, up to 3 stacks), past shields and armour. If it dies while Withering, its last life comes back to you: you regrow 10 health over 2 s.
skills.verb_fit: Wither is harm from within. The needle's damage is the small part; the Withering works inside the body, and what it takes out of a dying body is not wasted.
skills.change: Role shaping: a kill while Withering regrows you 10 over 2 s, so the healer's ranged starter feeds its healing.

new_mechanics.name: on_kill_heal
new_mechanics.definition: A skill key: if a target dies while carrying needs_status applied by the caster, the caster regrows heal over over_s (life healing order). Living targets only, so the unliving never pay it.

good_modifiers.word: a needle that drinks: Tithed as well, so your next hits on it heal you
it goes through one body into the next, withering each
a needle that flies true: 20% faster
the target cannot fight it off: Arrested, so the Withering does not run down

bad_modifiers.why: healing the body you are withering. No duration to lengthen; it falls back to a small damage bonus.
a needle turned on yourself, which no skill may do. It falls back to a small damage bonus.

skills.name: Fresh Stride
skills.summary: A 5.2 m dash on renewed legs. It never leaves you Winded and clears Winded if you are. For 3 s after you move 15% faster and regrow 3 health a second. It stops at bodies.
skills.verb_fit: Renew is restoring vigour and stamina. It is the one movement skill that removes fatigue instead of adding it, and the vigour it gives keeps mending you as you go.
skills.change: Role shaping: 3 health a second for the 3 s after (9, or 13 after a hit).

new_mechanics.name: clears_winded
new_mechanics.definition: Unchanged: casting removes Winded and, with never_winds, does not start it.

new_mechanics.name: after_heal_per_s
new_mechanics.definition: A movement-skill key: for the skill's duration after it ends the caster regrows after_heal_per_s (life healing order).

good_modifiers.word: a livelier stride: 25% faster, so 25% further
a stride that mends the strain: 25% less reflux, the mending a little longer
the fresh legs last half as long again
cheaper: 15% less essence

bad_modifiers.why: fatigue on the skill that cures fatigue. The dash hits nobody; it falls back to a small cost cut.
stops the mending the stride gives; Arrested has nobody to land on and the verbs cancel.

skills.name: Wearying Sweep
skills.summary: Everything within 3 m of you takes 1.7x strike damage and is Spent for 4 s (25% slower, attacks 30% slower). Every living enemy hit gives its stamina to you: 3 health over 3 s for each, up to 5.
skills.verb_fit: Exhaust drains stamina. The ring around you is suddenly tired, and the vigour it lost is drawn into your own body.
skills.change: Role shaping: regrowth on hit, 3 per living enemy struck (up to 15).

new_mechanics.name: heal_per_target
new_mechanics.definition: A skill key: for each living enemy the cast hits (up to heal_targets_max) the caster regrows heal_per_target over heal_over_s (life healing order).

good_modifiers.word: the weariness spreads: 30% wider ring, more bodies to draw on
tired and tapped: Tithed on everything hit, so your next strikes heal you too
tired and wasted at once: Spent and Wasted together
they drop where they stand: 30% more poise damage

bad_modifiers.why: restoring the stamina it drains. There is no speed to raise; the verbs cancel and the word should not form.
pierce means nothing on a burst, and the skill is already inside; it falls back to a small damage bonus.

skills.name: Corded Muscle
skills.summary: For 7 s your muscles thicken, and those of your living summons within 6 m: bare strikes do 40% more damage and 50% more poise damage, heavy blows take only half as much of your poise, and every point of health you regrow also refills a point of poise.
skills.verb_fit: Strengthen grows muscle and body. A body that is growing stands firmer as it heals.
skills.change: Living summons share it (radius); heals also refill poise while it lasts.

new_mechanics.name: heal_to_poise
new_mechanics.definition: A self_buff key: while it lasts, each health point the bearer regrows also restores heal_to_poise poise.

good_modifiers.word: the muscle stays half as long again
the body keeps building: 40% longer
strength given wider and longer: your summons further out take it
cheaper: 15% less essence

bad_modifiers.why: wasting the body you are building. A self buff hits nobody; it falls back to a small cost cut.
spreading a buff on one body; no reach or damage on the cast, so both halves fall back.

skills.name: Wasting Grip
skills.summary: One enemy in reach: a grip that wastes the body under it. 2.0x strike damage, and for 6 s it is Wasted: its blows do 30% less and its poise is cut to 60%. Open a Brute with it.
skills.verb_fit: Weaken wastes the body away: weaker blows and less to stand on. Utility: it is how a healer makes the big hitter survivable.

good_modifiers.word: wasted and tired: Wasted and Spent together
the grip drinks as it wastes: Tithed too
a longer, deeper grip: 30% harder, 30% longer wind-up
and it cannot recover: the wasting does not run down

bad_modifiers.why: mending the body you are wasting; falls back to a small damage bonus.
a grip is on one body; extra jumps fall back and the 15% damage loss lands.

skills.name: Fever Break
skills.summary: At once, ends every affliction of the body on you and your living summons within 6 m: burning, bleeding, poison, disease, withering, sickness and Winded. Each one ended lets the body mend: 4 health over 2 s (up to 4). For 5 s after, new afflictions last half as long.
skills.verb_fit: Cure ends a sickness or a poison. It works on what is wrong inside the body - not on holds and fear, which are Holy's to lift - and the freed body mends at once.
skills.change: Split from Holy's Absolution: Cure ends afflictions of the body (damage over time and sickness); binds (holds, slows, stagger, blinding, fear) are Holy's. Living summons share it; each affliction ended regrows 4.

new_mechanics.name: cleanse lists
new_mechanics.definition: cleanse names a list in balance.json: 'afflictions' (alight, bleeding, dosed, infected, withering, sick, winded and later damage-over-time or sickness statuses on the player) or 'binds' (staggered, slowed, pinned, mired, stunned, blinded, choked, terrified, dread and later holds). Each status gets one list. Life's Cure ends afflictions; Holy's Absolve lifts binds.

good_modifiers.word: the resistance lasts half as long again
the cure carried wider: your summons further out are cured
cheaper: 15% less essence
the body remembers the cure: 30% longer

bad_modifiers.why: making ill on the skill that cures; nobody to land on, it falls back to a small cost cut.
corrupting a cleanse; it falls back to a small cost cut.

skills.name: Turn the Stomach
skills.summary: One living enemy within 9 m is Sick for 8 s: every 2.5 s it retches, loses whatever it was doing and stands still for half a second. 20 damage.
skills.verb_fit: Sicken makes ill: one body that keeps breaking off to retch. Utility: a ranged answer to a caster or a drummer.

good_modifiers.word: a long illness: half as long again
sicken from 40% further away
sick and worn out: Sick and Spent together

bad_modifiers.why: curing the sickness as you give it; the verbs cancel and the word should not form.
a smite is not a shot; pierce falls back to a small damage bonus.

skills.name: Regrowth
skills.summary: Hold for up to 8 s, walking at 40%: 1.5 points a second go into your oldest wound until it closes and gives its share of the bar back, then into the next; a lost arm mends at half the rate. Living summons within 6 m regain 4.5 health a second. A blow no longer ends it: it stalls for 1 s and carries on.
skills.verb_fit: Regrow restores what was lost, limbs included. It is still the only skill that works the wound sinks first and brings an arm back.
skills.change: Usable in a fight: you can walk at 40% and a blow pauses it 1 s instead of ending it; living summons are mended too.

new_mechanics.name: pause_on_hit_s
new_mechanics.definition: A channel key: a blow taken stops the channel's effect (not its cost) for pause_on_hit_s instead of ending it (replaces breaks_on_hit).

good_modifiers.word: healing and regrowing together: 25% less reflux, a little longer
a calm, deep mending: 20% less reflux
you can hold it half as long again
cheaper to hold: 15% less essence a second

bad_modifiers.why: stopping the healing you are doing; it falls back to a small cost cut and the verbs cancel.
regrowth cannot be hurried and this channel has no wind-up; it falls back to a small cost cut.

skills.name: Unmending
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: after 0.4 s everything living within 3 m takes 30 and is Arrested for 8 s: it cannot heal or get its poise back, and the Life statuses on it stop running down. Cast it on the pack before the Censer-Bearer heals them.
skills.verb_fit: Arrest stops healing. Utility: the healer is also the one who denies the enemy its healing.

good_modifiers.word: a wider stoppage: 30% larger circle, a little softer
the arrest holds half as long again
what is stopped starts to wither: Withering on everyone caught
it lands sooner: 25% shorter delay

bad_modifiers.why: restoring what the skill stops from mending; the verbs cancel and the word should not form.
giving life to the bodies you are arresting; the verbs cancel.

skills.name: Lifeline
skills.summary: Hold on one living enemy within 8 m: a thread of its life runs into you. It takes 12 a second, past armour (a quarter more while it is Hale), and you regrow half of what it loses. You walk at 50%. The thread breaks if a wall comes between you or it gets 11 m away.
skills.verb_fit: Tithe takes life from a living body into yours. Life's healing that is paid for by the fight: the harder you hold the thread, the more you mend.

new_mechanics.name: drain
new_mechanics.definition: Unholy's drain key (unholy.json reaving_cleave): the caster is healed drain x the damage the hit actually deals, after every multiplier; the unliving give nothing. On a Life skill the heal follows the life healing order (bar, then sinks at a quarter) instead of Unholy's bar only, and counts as a heal over time for Life's after-hit rule.

new_mechanics.name: tithed
new_mechanics.definition: Enemy status, 1 stack, 6 s: every hit on it from whoever applied it heals them heals_attacker_frac 0.15 of the damage dealt (life healing order). Living targets only. The Tithe rune's effect.

good_modifiers.word: the thread withers what it drinks from: Withering on it, 10% harder
a longer thread: tied from 40% further
held half as long again
cheaper to hold: 15% less a second

bad_modifiers.why: giving back the life you are taking. The numbers would land (longer, wider) but the verbs cancel; the word should not form.
one thread, one body: a channel on a target does not jump; the 15% damage loss lands.

skills.name: Heartseed
skills.summary: You quicken a small living thing: a heartseed that floats at your shoulder for 15 s with 60 health. While it lives it pours 3 health a second into you and into your living summons within 6 m, and each hit you land makes it pulse 2 more into you. Enemies close by may strike it, and Life heals it. One at a time; it costs essence only, never your health.
skills.verb_fit: Bestow gives life outward into a body. With no friends to give it to, the healer gives life to a body of its own making, and that body gives it back - as long as you keep it alive.

new_mechanics.name: summon (generalised)
new_mechanics.definition: death.json's summon kind, widened: needs is optional (corpse, growth or none); the thrall dict gains model, living, behaviour (fight: walk to the nearest enemy and strike, as now; follow: keep beside the caster and do not attack) and any heal keys. Used by Life (Heartseed) and Nature (beasts).

new_mechanics.name: heal source
new_mechanics.definition: A thrall key set: heal_per_s to the caster and to the caster's living summons within the skill's radius, heal_per_hit to the caster each time the caster lands a hit (life healing order). strikable_within: enemies this close may choose it as a target; it holds no melee slot.

good_modifiers.word: the seed lives half as long again
a hardier seed: 20% stronger
it keeps itself whole: 40% longer
cheaper to quicken: 15% less essence

bad_modifiers.why: taking from the body you are giving life to. The verbs cancel; the word should not form.
a seed that withers on the stem; it hits nobody, so Withering falls back to a small cost cut.
